summary.text: Shelby Slawson is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 59 who has represented the district since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a business executive with a law degree.

paragraphs.text: Shelby Slawson earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2000 and a J.D. from the University of Texas at Austin in 2003.
Her career experience includes working as an entrepreneur and a business executive.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a native Central Texan raised in House District 59 and a first-generation college graduate.
Slawson took office on January 12, 2021, succeeding J.D. Sheffield.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Calendars, Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence, and House State Affairs.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Andrew Turner in the general election.
In her 2020 survey, she described her campaign messages as constitutional conservatism, taxpayer advocacy, and support for pro-life and Second Amendment positions.
